title: Boundary, dependency, and REF-002 non-promotion
statement: The T020 candidate must change only the declared T020-owned and shared paths, must bind to the exact baseline revision, must cite only accepted authorizations, must link the accepted X-COM software requirements and locators, must add no admitted dependency and no legacy coupling, and must record REF-002 disposition unchanged with an empty promoted set.
applicability: docs/engineering/xcom/t020/ requirements, architecture, design, unit, and verification work products
verification_intent: The changed-path boundary check and public-safety scan performed by the deterministic gate and the separate review.
acceptance_criteria: git diff --name-only is a subset of the declared path set and the baseline binds by git rev-parse.
The C++ suites include only admitted headers and the Python module imports only the standard library and repository modules.
REF-002 promoted set is empty and no public-safety leak is present.
